name: Onchain Recon Agent
description: Enterprise on-chain reconciliation agent by eidon-labs. Fetches EVM address transaction history across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Optimism, builds reconciliation reports (inflow/outflow/fees/net, top counterparties, daily activity, anomaly flags: failed txs, dust, counterparty bursts), and binds every report hash to a T3N DID attestation for tamper-evident audit trails.
